messages:
maria: FYI customer ACME hit a big p99 regression for their Dedicated pool during billing window — lots of 503s and 5-10s p99 spikes. They filed an urgent ticket.
kevin: link to metrics? latency / attach / error breakdowns?
june-cs: customer says it started ~2024-11-02 18:05 UTC, coincides with their daily invoice-run burst. p95 ~800ms -> 2.4s, p99 ~3.2s -> 15s. Errors: 503 + handful of 401s.
maria: attaching their timeline and sample request IDs in the ticket.
tara: can you post the pool id and model? possible Dedicated pool saturation or cold GPU start storm.
maria: pool: ded-pool-az3-acme, model: llama-40b-q8 (verified). pool min_size=2, max_size=10, autoscale policy=standard. customer traffic spiked x12 for ~7m.
kevin: prelim logs: attach queue depth spiked, many warmup attachments started in parallel. We see image-pull delays ~20-30s on some hosts + 1-2s kernel init. A subset of GPUs returned cold-start stalls.
sam: infra-bot summarized provisioning events: 
```
2024-11-02T18:05:12Z provisioning-request pool=ded-pool-az3-acme size=8
2024-11-02T18:05:13Z image-pull start host=h12
2024-11-02T18:05:25Z image-pull failed host=h12: timed out
2024-11-02T18:05:30Z fallback host=h13 used
2024-11-02T18:05:40Z attach success host=h13
```
kevin: that image-pull timeout path is important. If several hosts time out concurrently, attach stalls cascade -> large queue -> p99 spikes. Also saw a short auth rotation for the pool's service-account at 18:04:50 that produced ~30 401s before retry.
tara: auth rotation + image-pull jitter + burst = perfect storm. Host image cache TTL is 30m but some hosts evicted image a bit early after a neardisk pressure event.
maria: customer wants immediate mitigation and a postmortem plan. short-term?
kevin: immediate mitigation options (ordered):
- increase pool.min_size to 4 for this pool (quick config change)
- temporarily route priority customer to hosted fallback model (llama-40b-q8-hosted) until warmup completes
- bump concurrent attach throttle to smooth image pulls (slow the fanout)
- add a one-off pre-pull to nodes in az3 (run image-pull job)

june-cs: customer prefers fallback route if it's low-lift.
sam: I can kick an infra job to pre-pull images to a small set of nodes in the AZ. will need approval to touch customer pool min.
tara: approved. also trigger a temporary hold on any automated image garbage collection in az3 for next 30m.
kevin: I'll prepare commands. To bump min_size:
```
redwoodctl pools update ded-pool-az3-acme --min-size=4
```
To route to hosted fallback (short-term):
```
redwoodctl routes set --customer=acme --route=hosted:llama-40b-q8-hosted
```
kevin: additionally, to reduce attach storm set attach_fanout_rate to 10/s:
```
redwoodctl pools update ded-pool-az3-acme --attach-fanout=10
```
maria: do we expect any billing impact for the min_size bump? customer billed for Dedicated reserved capacity already; they'll be happy to avoid outages.
tara: minimal incremental charge for the minutes of extra nodes; we should inform billing.
kevin: also adding a short-term fallback policy in the control plane: if attach queue > 100 -> route new requests to compatible hosted variant. I'll open a quick rollbackable rollout.
kevin: opened PR for emergency rollout: deploy-bot: 4332110122 deploy started.
deploy-bot: emergency-rollout/attach-throttle -> SUCCESS (canary)
maria: did the pre-pull job run?
sam: pre-pull started at 4332110200, finished at 4332110280. logs show 0 timeouts after pre-pull.
june-cs: customer confirmed p99 dropped back to ~900ms within 5 minutes after fallback routing and pre-pull. They still saw a few 401s tied to auth rotation.\eira: (typo)
kevin: typo noted. For the 401s: we saw a short-lived key rotation event for the pool SA. Ops will patch the rotation to overlap tokens next time. Action: change rotation grace window to 120s.
tara: long-term mitigation candidates:
- increase image cache TTL for critical AZs
- proactive pre-pull during known billing windows (scheduled prewarm jobs)
- increase default pool.min_size for customers with regular daily spikes
- make attach fanout adaptive by observing image-pull success rate
- stronger monitoring alert for image-pull timeout rate -> automated prewarm trigger
kevin: I'll own the engineering playbook updates and a postmortem note. sam please add the pre-pull job to the scheduled runbook for acme's billing window. maria please update customer ticket with remediation steps and ETA.
sam: will add one-off runbook and schedule.
maria: customer escalated to priority-sev. I told them we did a routed fallback and pre-pull; p99 improved and 401s were transient. they want written RCA in 48h.
june-cs: adding to CS tracker.
kevin: postmortem actions:
- (P0) change pool.min default and evaluate churn cost (owner: kevin)
- (P0) fix image-gc behavior and add pre-pull automation (owner: tara)
- (P1) extend token rotation grace period for pool SAs (owner: ops)
- (P1) add alert for attach-queue > threshold (owner: eng-sre)
- (P2) model fallback auto-policy proof-of-concept (owner: eng-platform)

maria: thanks everyone. will close loop with customer after PM doc. :thumbsup:
kevin: filing internal incident ticket now. ticket id: I-2024-ACME-72
